pros: Strong security features like zero-trust and secure password sharing without revealing credentials.
Efficient item creation and organization, allowing quick entry of various data types and easy retrieval.
Excellent value for money compared to other password managers.
cons: Browser extension can sometimes be inconsistent with autofill suggestions or require frequent master password entry.
The user interface might feel less polished or intuitive compared to some competitors.
Admin features for managing collections and permissions for teams can be complex, with a disjointed experience between personal vaults and organizational management.
changed: Replaced pro #2 (Efficient password generation and autofill across devices, saving time) with 'Efficient item creation and organization, allowing quick entry of various data types and easy retrieval.' based on notes: '[benefit] The Add button offers Login, Card, Identity, Note, SSH key and Folder in one dropdown, so starting a CRM login or a server-access note took two clicks.' and '[benefit] A login or secure note saves with only the Item name filled (username and password optional), so the CRM entry and the server-access note were each created in about three actions.' and '[benefit] The vault and the org collections view both have a filter panel by type (Login, Card, Identity, Secure note, SSH key), plus Collections, Trash and a search box.' This is a more specific and broader benefit related to item handling.
